verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs present it as a Git-based platform, with sections on working with Git, SSH keys, and personal access tokens. Community users describe pushing code to it, which confirms that standard Git push works in practice. However, the evidence is mostly section titles and anecdotes rather than explicit clone/pull/push instructions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cloning, pulling and pushing over HTTPS and over SSH with standard Git clients, and documented HTTPS credential use (token-as-password) for Git operations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone, pull, and push repositories with any standard Git client over HTTPS or SSH
